note: Four decks, fifteen slides each, in three sizes. Pick by register, not by taste — see decks/README.md. More than one deck on screen at once means one of each.

decks.title: IBM Security — Cost of a Data Breach Report
decks.use: A deck that must read as serious work — enterprise, compliance, analyst, report. Light, dense, charts and data tables.

decks.title: Nayture — Building a Brand Like Patagonia
decks.use: A deck that must look good small — thumbnails, galleries, template pickers, covers. Loud photography and colour blocks.

decks.title: Palantir — Q1 Investor Presentation
decks.use: Dark slides — light chrome over dark content, or a finance / metrics context. Near-black, big numbers, financial tables.

decks.title: Refresh — Capabilities Deck
decks.use: Slides that stay legible and distinct from each other at any size — filmstrips, step-throughs, nav. Minimal, black and electric blue.
